reason: The two independent pilot flows passed finest-pair screens, but 24-to-32 FTLE changes were 0.00414 and 0.00567, and response changes 0.000603 and 0.000497. Use the better-resolved 32-grid for all production flows rather than interpreting tiny effects on the coarse grid.
pilot_data: pilot-data/ and pilot-results/numerical-audit.json; pilot seeds 60000 and 60001 are excluded from all model fitting and scientific effect inference
unchanged: Equations, initial fields, forcing, marker evaluation, target horizons, interventions, seeds/splits, model classes, statistical units and numerical tolerances remain as in protocol.json.
production: 40 independent fresh flows at n=32; all 12 test flows at n=24 and n=48; all 12 test flows at n=32 half-step and two at n=48 half-step. Duration, probe-amplitude and viscosity sensitivity use n=32.
claim_gate: The applicable production-to-finest effect change is n=32 to n=48; n=24 is a diagnostic, not part of the production-effect bias estimate. Predictions trained at n=32 are also evaluated frozen at n=48 without refitting.
